ui.title: Player profile & progression
ui.description: A purple player profile with levels, XP, titles, and unlockable banners. Everything a player needs to show off their progress, in one place.

ui.title: Fantasy inventory & equipment
ui.description: A dark fantasy inventory with room for your items, equipment, and the details that matter. Gold accents help you spot what's selected and equipped.

ui.description: Bright buttons, clear currency counters, and quick access to shops, pets, rebirths, and codes. A playful HUD made for a busy simulator.

ui.description: A fantasy HUD with Shop, Play, and Classes right where you'd expect them. Dark panels and warm borders keep the whole interface feeling connected.
